CustomField.description: Whether an archive rule's run starts without first backing up its records to Files (D-223, ADR-0240 amendment AR-15). Shipped false: every run is backed up first and starts only once the backup is saved in full.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Start archive rule runs without the backup to Files that otherwise comes first. Riskier: a run that goes wrong has no backup to restore from.
CustomField.label: Skip Backup Before Archive
